name: Pierre Wibaux
role: Owner of the Royal Chambord ranch on Beaver Creek
bio: Pierre Wibaux became sole proprietor of the Royal Chambord cattle ranch on Beaver Creek, and of a bull ranch on the Little Missouri, when his partnership with Gustave Grisy ended on November 1, 1884; his post office was Mingusville. That winter he advertised that all bulls from the round-up would be received at Royal Chambord. In 1885 he was among the members of the Little Missouri River Stockmen's Association, and in May 1886 his brother from France visited him at the ranch, where the round-up held a roping contest in June.
